overall: The AG found the Select Board violated the Open Meeting Law by deliberating at a Council on Aging meeting without posting notice, but found no intentional violation and declined to review the claim against Town Counsel.

allegations.summary: Board members attending a Council on Aging meeting allegedly deliberated on a Town Hall and senior facility location without the Board having posted notice.
allegations.key_passage: The three Board members did not speak in their capacity as members of the general public, but rather in their capacity as members of the Board.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the Board members acted intentionally to violate the Open Meeting Law, with the Board allowed to speak while the public was not.
allegations.key_passage: We have not previously warned the Board against the violation found here, nor do we find other evidence that would support finding an intentional violation.

allegations.summary: Complainant contended that the public being denied the chance to speak at the Council meeting, while Board members spoke, was improper.
allegations.key_passage: Therefore, that the public was denied the opportunity to speak at the June 29 meeting does not violate the Open Meeting Law and does not form a basis for finding that the Board intentionally violated the Law.

allegations.summary: Complaint named Town Counsel as violating the Open Meeting Law.
allegations.key_passage: The Open Meeting Law applies only to public bodies and their members; therefore, we decline to review any allegations that Town Counsel violated the Open Meeting Law.

remedy: Immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law
remedy_passage: We order immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law, and caution that similar violations in the future may be considered evidence of intent to violate the Law.
note: Read by a language model from the letter; every key passage is checked verbatim against it and dropped if not. A holding is the Attorney General’s reading of the law in this case only.
